title: Angel Hotel
description: angelpershore.co.uk zoominfo.com/c/angel-hotel/1153643926 The Angel, Pershore is a historic Tudor-origin hotel and restaurant located in the heart of the market town of Pershore, Worcestershire, near the River Avon. It serves as a premier venue offering farm-to-table dining with locally sourced produce, comfortable accommodation, and a charming atmosphere. Beyond hospitality, the establishment is a vibrant community hub, regularly hosting live music, festivals, and popular annual events like Bonfire Night fireworks.
